description: This Java class 'WeightPackageSession' manages shipment packaging details, including creating package lines, calculating shipping costs, updating shipment segments, and handling UPS-specific shipment confirmation processes within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: WeightPackageSession
classes.description: Manages shipment weight packages, including package creation, cost estimation, UPS integration, and shipment status updates within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: createWeightPackageLine
methods.description: Creates a new package line with specified dimensions and shipment box type, adding it to the session.

methods.name: getShippableWeight
methods.description: Calculates total weight of items in the package for a given order.

methods.name: complete
methods.description: Finalizes the shipment process, including package creation, cost calculation, order status updates, and shipment packing.

methods.name: completeShipment
methods.description: Completes shipment process without package creation, updating shipment status and order items.

methods.name: upsShipmentConfirm
methods.description: Confirms shipment with UPS, retrieving actual shipping costs.

methods.name: upsShipmentAccept
methods.description: Accepts UPS shipment, updating shipment segments.

methods.name: diffInShipCost
methods.description: Checks if the difference between estimated and actual shipping costs exceeds allowed threshold.

methods.name: createPackages
methods.description: Creates shipment packages based on packed lines.

methods.name: changeOrderItemStatus
methods.description: Updates order item statuses to completed.

methods.name: applyItemsToPackages
methods.description: Associates order items with their respective packages.

methods.name: updateShipmentRouteSegments
methods.description: Updates shipment route segments with total billing weight.

methods.name: savePackagesInfo
methods.description: Creates and optionally confirms UPS shipment packages.

methods.name: getOrderedQuantity
methods.description: Returns total quantity of approved order items.
